verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Terraform includes a hosted service (HCP Terraform) that stores user state and configuration, and it has AI-facing features such as the MCP server. A buyer could fairly ask whether their data is excluded from AI model training. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use control for AI. The MCP server items concern giving AI models access to registry docs, not restricting training on user data.
